feedback.problem:
Let $T$ be the linear transformation with matrix representation $T$ given by

$$
T=[\begin{aligned}2 & 1 \\ 1 & 0\end{aligned}].
$$

A line segment $\overset{―}{RS}$ has endpoints at $R(0,2)$ and $S(-1,1).$ What are the coordinates of the corresponding endpoints $\overset{―}{{R}^{′}{S}^{′}}$, the image of $\overset{―}{RS}$ under the action of $T?$

${R}^{′}($ 
{{field-1}}, 
{{field-2}}
$)\,$ and $\,{S}^{′}($ 
{{field-3}}, 
{{field-4}}
$)$
feedback.worked_solution:
To find the image of $\overset{―}{RS}$ under the action of $T$, we first create a matrix $X$ containing the coordinates of the endpoints of $\overset{―}{RS}:$

$$
X=[\begin{aligned}0 & -1 \\ 2 & 1\end{aligned}].
$$

Now, we compute the image of $X$ under the action of $T$ by calculating the matrix product $TX:$

$$
\begin{aligned}TX & =[\begin{aligned}2 & 1 \\ 1 & 0\end{aligned}][\begin{aligned}0 & -1 \\ 2 & 1\end{aligned}] \\  & =[\begin{aligned}2 & -1 \\ 0 & -1\end{aligned}].\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore, the coordinates of the respective endpoints of the image are ${R}^{′}(2,0)$ and ${S}^{′}(-1,-1).$
